video_title: Stephen A. sends a REMINDER about Victor Wembanyama ahead of Game 5 🗣️ | First Take

quotes.speaker: Markieff Morris
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama needs a better second half performance in Game 5
quotes.excerpt: He just has to play a better second half. It's not even about the full game.
quotes.quote: He just has to play a better second half. It's not even about the full game. The last game, he completely dominated the first half of that game. I remember he hit a shot on Mitchell Robinson and he turned around and pointed at his head like he was in his head. Yes, he was. He played a great first half. He just needs to finish the game.

quotes.speaker: Markieff Morris
quotes.summary_phrase: The Knicks are a bottom-five team at protecting the rim
quotes.excerpt: The Knicks are a bottom-five worst team for protecting the rim.
quotes.quote: The Knicks are a bottom-five worst team for protecting the rim. Everything has to be in the paint for him. Let him work inside and work out. Like Game 4, everything they were throwing from 30 feet away to Wembanyama in the paint and he was just catching and finishing. They have to do more of that.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Stephen A. Smith criticizes Charlie Mack's basketball analysis
quotes.excerpt: I get a text message from Charlie Mack, trying to tell me about basketball analysis.
quotes.quote: I get a text message from Charlie Mack, trying to tell me about basketball analysis. You understand what I'm saying? This is the dude that told me the Sixers were going to be the Finals. Sit down, Charlie. Sit down, the Sixers are home. Sixers are home. Just watch, just listen, okay?

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is averaging 27.8 points in the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I just want to remind y'all the brother is averaging 28 and 10 on 43 percent shooting.
quotes.quote: I just want to remind y'all the brother is averaging 28 and 10 on 43 percent shooting. That's a bad series for Victor Wembanyama in his first NBA Finals. Keep that in mind, y'all. Keep that 28 and 10, 27.8 to be exact, but 28 and 10.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama is playing nearly 12 minutes in the fourth quarter
quotes.excerpt: He's averaging 11.8 minutes in the fourth quarter of the NBA Finals.
quotes.quote: He's averaging 11.8 minutes in the fourth quarter of the NBA Finals. He's not really getting any break. And you got him running all over the place trying to be a deterrent. So all of those things are possible.

quotes.speaker: Markieff Morris
quotes.summary_phrase: Markieff Morris picks OG Anunoby for NBA Finals MVP
quotes.excerpt: I'm going to go with the OG Anunoby route. He's been super efficient on offense, super efficient on defense.
quotes.quote: I'm going to go with the OG Anunoby route. He's been super efficient on offense, super efficient on defense and he's been the unsung hero. He's doing everything on the floor. He's attacking the defensive player of the year like he's not 7'5. He's dumped on him about two, three times. You can go down the line of shots he's made, plays he's made, and that tip really solidifies it. So if I have to pick somebody right now, it would be OG.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson played to win the Finals MVP in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: What I thought he did in Game 3 was play to win the Finals MVP.
quotes.quote: What I thought he did in Game 3 was play to win the Finals MVP instead of playing to win Game 3. That's how his game looked and that was my issue. He didn't get Karl-Anthony Towns involved, he didn't get Mikal Bridges involved. OG had 28 points on 13 shots. He didn't get OG more shots.

quotes.speaker: Stephen A. Smith
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson is the heartbeat of the New York Knicks
quotes.excerpt: He's the heartbeat of the team, he's 6'1 guard carried this franchise to a championship.
quotes.quote: He's the heartbeat of the team, he's 6'1 guard carried this franchise to a championship. That's why you would give him the MVP and nobody would knock that. But I'm telling you, in terms of consistency, games one through four, it has been OG.
